column1: # Sarah: a human with a gun, met four times (Vault, Kalay, Tolbi, Lalivero), stronger each time.

column3:
You again, Isaac.
Still traveling east?{page_break}I heard a rumor here.
A girl with golden hair
and violet eyes.{end_wait}

Someone I must find.
I can't say more.{page_break}You've grown stronger.
Let's see if you can
stand against me now.{end_wait}

You've improved.
I can see that.{page_break}If you hear anything
about the girl,
remember our talk.{end_wait}

You there. Isaac, yes?
I'm Sarah, a knight
from the Western lands.{page_break}I'm seeking a girl.
Short golden hair.
Purple eyes.{page_break}No? Then draw your sword.
I want to see how
you handle yourself.{end_wait}

Enough. You fought well.
I'll remember you.{page_break}If our roads cross
again, we'll see
what you've learned.{end_wait}

Isaac. I found a lead.
A girl like the one
I've been seeking.{page_break}They say she's staying
under Babi's care.
Do you know anything?{end_wait}

I gave my word.
That's all I'll say.{page_break}You're not stepping
aside, are you?
Then face me.{end_wait}

You still won't yield.
I can respect that.{page_break}But if you meet her,
let me speak to her.
Just once.{end_wait}

Isaac. You're here.
And so is the trail
I've followed for years.{page_break}A girl matching
that description
was seen near here.{end_wait}
You still haven't\ntold me what happens\nwhen you find her.{end_wait}

I've followed rumors
all this way. I've yet
to see her myself.{page_break}If she's the one,
I have a duty to her.
I won't tell you more.{page_break}If you mean to stop me,
Isaac, then draw.
One last time.{end_wait}

That's enough.
You made your point.{page_break}I don't even know
if she's the girl
I'm looking for.{page_break}I owe her the truth.
I need to find it
before I act.{end_wait}
